about: The verbs the Horizon games teach as core play: the overlap table of docs/ROUND5-BIBLE.md §11.2 plus the genre verbs it assumes. Read by A-distinct-verbs (progression, W3; plan §9): it passes when at least 5 of the 8 first-hour beats (bible §8.9) teach a verb whose id is NOT listed here. Bible §11.2 names the seven beats that qualify (raking salt, crossing a transect unseen, triangulating, toppling a tripod by its level vial, parrying / planting the Windwall / luring a Screed into a wall, re-surveying a benchmark, moving under the calima); the one that does not is 0:05, Sighting, which is the scan loop below. Brand-owned lint data (plan §2); tools/lint/** is excluded from the code lint (plan §7.4).
match: by id: a beat declares the id of the verb it teaches; a beat whose verb is a CALIMA rename of a listed verb (the calima field) teaches that listed verb

verbs.horizon: Focus scan: highlight components, weak points, patrol paths
tag a machine and follow its tracks or path with the Focus
draw a bow, aim, loose; headshots and component shots
Concentration: aim in slowed time
calima: Steady (changed: a breath-hold, no time dilation)

verbs.horizon: the weapon wheel slows time
calima: Kit Rack (changed: the world keeps running)

verbs.horizon: Silent Strike from tall grass or behind
Critical Strike on a knocked-down machine
tear or detach a component with tear damage, then loot it
fire / freeze / shock statuses; frozen makes the target brittle for extra damage
fill a machine's knockdown meter with impact or blast damage until it falls
stealth in red brush; machines lose sight of you
whistle or throw a rock to lure a machine to you
lay tripwires and traps on a machine's path
Ropecaster: tie a machine to the ground
calima: Cast Net (changed: fouling, small and medium only)

verbs.horizon: override a machine so it fights for you or carries you
climb along marked handholds
climb a colossal walker and download the region's map
light and heavy spear combos, the resonator blast
roll out of an attack
pick plants, loot containers and wrecks
craft ammunition on the move
spend skill points earned from kills and quests on skill trees
calima: Field Book certifications (changed: earned by survey acts)

verbs.horizon: glide from heights
grapple to anchor points; pull walls and boxes
swim and dive under water
fight through a machine-factory interior and override its core
